verdict.rationale: Cognee's core architecture explicitly builds a knowledge graph of entities and relationships from ingested data, with .remember constructing the graph and .recall retrieving via the best available source including graph traversal; runtime probes confirm a real graph (47 nodes/86 edges) was loaded and entity-centric queries answered end-to-end locally. This directly matches the entity-centric, multi-hop memory story for an ml-engineer. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or hands-on evidence specifically demonstrating multi-hop question answering accuracy (vs. single-hop lexical retrieval), and no explicit doc/example walking through a multi-hop entity-relationship query.
